buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to

increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PRINCIPAL ITI JUNAGADH payable at JUNAGADH . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C PRINCIPAL ITI JUNAGADH . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.The agency will have to upload all documents related to registration, such as the GST certificate, PA N card, proof of address (must attach proof of having an office in the state of Gujarat), and other r egistration documents. 2.As per Gujarat State Procurement Policy 2024 the minimum average annual financial turnover of bid der during last three years ending on 31st march of previous financial year, should be at least twi ce the bid value. Valid documents as prescribed under the Gujarat State Procurement Policy–2024 shall be submitted in support of the same. 3.The agency will have to submit a certificate of experience for the past three years. In this regard, va lid documents must be submitted in accordance with the Gujarat State Procurement Policy – 2024. 4.The agency must upload latest notarized affidavit stating that it is not blacklisted or banned by any government department. 5.The bidder must upload a certificate on the agency's letterhead demonstrating the reasonableness of the quoted rates. 6.The bidder must upload copies of the GST returns for the last three months. 7.The bidding agency must upload a affidavit on agency's letterhead for the AUTHORIZED SIGNATORY in the prescribed format. For a proprietorship firm, if the proprietor wishes to appoint any other person as the AUTHORIZED SIGNATORY, they too must upload affidavit on agency's letterhead. 8.The agency must submit affidavit on agency's letterhead for the LAND BORDER COUNTRY DECLARA TION in the prescribed format. 9.The agency must submit a certificate on its letterhead showcasing the complete specifications of th e goods to be supplied, clearly indicating their make, model number, and specifications. Upon awa rd of the contract, if a different make or model with identical specifications is supplied after obtain ing the institution's approval, it will be acceptable; however, items differing from the stated specifi cations cannot be supplied. The agency must submit a "No Deviation Certificate" for the said bid o n its letterhead in the prescribed format. The seller must quote reasonable rates for all items inclu ded in the bid and upload a certificate regarding the same on the agency's letterhead. 10.Exemption from EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) shall be admissible under the Gujarat State Procure ment Policy – 2024, and the necessary documents for the same must be uploaded. 11.If the agency wishes to claim purchase preference in accordance with the Gujarat State Procureme nt Policy – 2024, they must submit the Valid documents. 12.The buyer reserves the absolute right to split the order or increase/decrease the quantity, for whic h no additional charges or any other compensation will be paid. The agency must supply the good s as instructed by the institution along with the order. 13.The agency must deposit the original copy of the EMD in the form of a Demand Draft, Pay Order an d Bank Guarantee calculated at 3% of the estimated bid value amounting to Rs. 5160 /- (Rupees Fi ve Thousand One Hundred sixty only), at the institution within 5 days of bid completion in the na me of “PRINCIPAL ITI JUNAGADH”. Also upload scan copy of EMD with Additional Terms & Conditio ns (ATC) / OTHER UPLOADED DOCUMENTS. 14.Security Deposit Terms and Conditions- 14.1 - An amount equivalent to 5% of the total Work Order value shall be deposited as a Security Deposit in the form of a Demand Draft drawn in favour of “PRINCIPAL ITI JUNAGADH” within 15 days fr om the date of the GeM Order. No interest of any kind shall be payable on the Security Deposit am ount. 14.2- The Security Deposit shall be refunded to the agency upon completion of inspection of all goods by iti committee. 15.The agency must attach a self-declaration for local content as specified in Annexure – 1. 16.The entire quantity as per the work order must be delivered together to the institution within the st ipulated time limit. 17.If the goods are supplied after the stipulated time limit, a penalty will be deducted from the bill in a ccordance with government rules. 18.Payment of bills will be processed according to government rules. In the event of any delay in pay ment, no interest or additional compensation of any kind will be paid in return.

19.The supplier must produce original documents for verification if requested by the institution. 20.The bidder must mandatory upload the Scope of Work and its underlying Additional Terms & Condi tions (ATC) on the GeM portal along with the bid, indicating acceptance with the company stamp o n their letterhead. A Scope of Work and underlying Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) uploaded without the bidder's letterhead or without signature and stamp will not be valid, and the purchase committee reserves the full right to disqualify such a bidder. 21.The institution reserves the full right to accept, reject, cancel, or re-invite the bid or any part of the bid without assigning any reason. 22.All required documents must be uploaded in accordance with all the aforementioned terms and co nditions. Otherwise, the seller will be considered for disqualification during the technical evaluatio n. 23.In the event of any dispute arising in connection with this bid/agreement, the jurisdiction shall excl usively be JUNAGADH. 24.The supplier shall be solely responsible for the supply, delivery to the site, unloading, of all goods a nd associated accessories covered under the bid in a fully functional and Ready-to-Use condition. . 9.
